stem: How did Samuel Morse's best-known innovation contribute to U.S. growth and development?

options.label: F
options.text: It enabled instantaneous long-distance transmission of information.

options.label: G
options.text: It allowed manufactured goods to be produced at lower costs.

options.label: H
options.text: It boosted the speed of cross-country mail delivery.

options.label: J
options.text: It increased national unity by reducing sectional differences.
